aboutGame.title: What is Mega Man Dual Override?
paragraphs: Mega Man Dual Override is Capcom's next side-scrolling action platformer in the classic Mega Man series. Set for Spring 2027, it follows Mega Man and Proto Man as they confront a robot uprising tied to an exhibition gone wrong, with each hero offering a distinct combat style across the same stage list.

Players can pair the Blue Bomber's charged buster and Special Weapons with Proto Man's faster, shield-focused approach. Before each stage, a chip loadout reshapes the run, while the Override system trades a temporary surge in power for a vulnerable recovery period.

faq.title: Mega Man Dual Override FAQ
faq.description: Quick answers about Mega Man Dual Override release timing, heroes, Custom Chips, and Override combat.

items.question: When does Mega Man Dual Override release?
items.answer: Mega Man Dual Override is scheduled for Spring 2027. The confirmed storefront is Steam on PC, and the official game page is open for wishlists.

items.question: Who are the playable characters in Mega Man Dual Override?
items.answer: Mega Man Dual Override features two playable heroes: Mega Man and Proto Man. Each has a distinct combat style, and every stage can be tackled with either character.

items.question: What are Custom Chips in Mega Man Dual Override?
items.answer: Mega Man Dual Override uses a pre-stage chip loadout. Attack Chip doubles charged buster shots, Defense Chip adds a shield and E-Tank, and Rush Chip provides spring-based mobility.

items.question: How does the Override system work in Mega Man Dual Override?
items.answer: Mega Man Dual Override lets a hero release their limiter for a temporary power surge. After Override ends, the character enters a weakened recovery period, so timing matters more than raw damage.

items.question: Which hero should beginners choose in Mega Man Dual Override?
items.answer: Start Mega Man Dual Override with Mega Man for charged buster safety, then replay stages as Proto Man once you know the layouts and want a more aggressive combat style.

items.question: Where can I find Mega Man Dual Override boss guides?
items.answer: The Mega Man Dual Override wiki organizes Robot Master profiles, stage patterns, and boss preparation in one guide hub, with Twinkle Girl and Jet Man already featured.
